basic_info.description: Live the ultimate San Francisco lifestyle in this renovated Cow Hollow condo! The flexible, two-story floor plan includes an open living area with kitchen, dining room and light-filled family room with built-in bookcase and bay window. The chef's kitchen features high-end appliances, marble counters, dishwasher and island with bar seating. A spacious bedroom located on the main level connects to a renovated bathroom with laundry. An additional bonus room could be used as an office, den, third bedroom or converted back to a single bedroom. The primary suite is located downstairs, featuring a walk-in closet with built-in organizers, renovated full bath and access to the back yard. The unit includes one tandem parking space in the garage. Other features include in-unit stackable laundry, oak floors, recessed lighting, crown molding, fresh interior paint, Restoration Hardware finishes and built-in speakers. The two-unit HOA is well managed with low monthly dues. Just steps from the historic Balboa Cafe, this home is situated between the vibrant Union and Chestnut Street corridors with a walk score of 99. The best of Cow Hollow awaits!
